content.short: Virtuals Protocol is a Base-native platform for creating and co-owning autonomous AI agents with fractional tokens.
content.description: Virtuals Protocol is a pioneering decentralized ecosystem built on the Base network, designed to facilitate the creation, co-ownership, and management of autonomous AI agents. The platform features a unique "fractionalized agent" model, where every AI persona—capable of interacting across X, Roblox, and TikTok—has its own 1 billion supply token launched on a bonding curve. This allows community members to gain governance rights and a share in the agent's revenue. Powered by the VIRTUAL token and G.A.M.E. Engine, the protocol ensures that agents maintain a consistent persona.
content.meta: Virtuals Protocol provides a decentralized platform for creating AI agents. Discover Virtuals Protocol and other Social Dapps on Lancers Explorer.
